searchResults.title: Suntory PepsiCo marks 30 years of investment and sustainable development in Vietnam
searchResults.highlight:
During this journey, the company has accompanied Vietnam by continuously bolstering investments and scaling up business and production. From the first flagship products, Pepsi and 7UP, the company’s product portfolio has evolved significantly to 13 diverse brands, serving millions of Vietnamese consumers annually and maintaining the leading position in the beverage industry for over 20 years.
...
Sustainable development lies at the heart of Suntory PepsiCo’s operations to bring sustainable values to the community and shape a better Vietnam. The company is committed to supporting the government’s sustainable development goals by resolving pressing environmental,
...
, and community problems.
...
Suntory PepsiCo’s strategy is based on six key pillars that benefit people and the planet, including creating positive impact on water resources, reducing greenhouse gas emissions, using sustainable packaging, taking care of consumers’ and employees’ health, cultivating a diversity, equity, and inclusion environment, and enriching the community’s lives.
...
Suntory PepsiCo’s commitment to sustainability is reflected in its packaging. The company has pioneered reductions in the use of virgin plastic used, introducing packaging made from 100 per cent rPET and using education to change community behaviour to boost waste collection and recycling.
...
In 2022, it became the first beverage company in Vietnam to launch a rPET Pepsi bottle, followed by the Oolong TEA+ in 2023. Such initiatives helped the company reduce 5,000 tonnes of virgin plastic used in packaging annually, equal to a reduction of 23,000 tonnes of carbon emissions.
...
To boost community’s health, the company has innovated its products with more healthy beverage options. This is coupled with cultivating an inclusive environment for employees. At Suntory PepsiCo, women hold 36 per cent of leadership positions. This is part of the diversity, equity, and inclusion strategy across the company, which aims to empower women, nurture talent, and build a diverse working environment that’s key to the company’s sustainable development.
